observations.behavior: Adds two database columns to the HogQL metrics schema: metric_types and metric_type.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the OTel metric types received by a service, and the first type, to support filtering and deduplication of metric names. This could help the metrics picker distinguish between metrics of different types without scanning the full series table.
